name: from_ptr
declaration: const unsafe fn from_ptr < 'a > (ptr : * mut bool) -> & 'a AtomicBool
rules: `ptr` must be aligned to `align_of::<AtomicBool>()`, which is always 1.
`ptr` must be valid for reads for the whole lifetime `'a`.
`ptr` must be valid for writes for the whole lifetime `'a`.
You must adhere to the memory model for atomic accesses.
Atomic and non-atomic accesses must not be mixed without synchronization.
Atomic accesses of different sizes must not be mixed without synchronization.
